name: natui-monorepo
description: Write React TypeScript, render real native UI: SwiftUI on macOS, WinUI 3 on Windows.

scripts.demo: pnpm --filter natui build && pnpm --filter natui-demo dev
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter natui build && pnpm --filter natui-demo verify
scripts.verify:kitchen: pnpm --filter natui build && pnpm --filter natui-kitchen-sink verify
scripts.verify:embedded: pnpm --filter natui build && pnpm --filter natui-demo build:embedded && node examples/demo/src/verify-embedded.mjs
